about.title: About FICAS
paragraphs: The Forensic Investigation Case Administration System (FICAS) was built to solve a core problem: the overwhelming amount of manual paperwork and fragmented information in forensic case management.
FICAS empowers forensic investigators, legal professionals and administrative staff to manage cases digitally, reducing the risk of lost information and improving collaboration across teams.

By centralising case data, automating routing and providing clear role-based access, FICAS helps teams deliver faster, more accurate results while maintaining a complete, auditable history of every case.
